name: Can new windows significantly reduce my heating and cooling costs?

mainEntity.name: Can new windows significantly reduce my heating and cooling costs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, replacing old, drafty windows with energy-efficient models can significantly reduce your heating and cooling costs. Up to 30% of a home's heat loss occurs through windows and doors. Modern windows with features like double-pane glass, Low-E coatings, and insulated frames create a better thermal barrier, keeping conditioned air inside and minimizing the need for your HVAC system to work harder.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, new energy-efficient windows can significantly reduce heating and cooling costs by preventing heat loss.
